ns2:section.sectionText: Introduction to the concepts and methodology of Bayesian statistics, for students with fundamental knowledge of mathematical statistics. Topics include Bayes' rule, prior and posterior distributions, conjugacy, Bayesian point estimates and intervals, Bayesian hypothesis testing, noninformative priors, practical Markov Chain Monte Carlo, hierarchical models and model graphs, and more advanced topics as time permits. Implementations in R and OpenBUGS. Prerequisites: STAT 410 and knowledge of R. Restricted to students majoring in Statistics or Statistics & Computer Science until November 25, 2013.
